text:
Words? Yes, made of air,
+
+and lost in air.
+
+
+Let me lose myself among words,
+
+let me be the air upon a pair of lips,
+
+a wandering breath without contours
+
+that air dissolves.
+
+
+Light too loses itself within itself.

translation.title: Words? Yes, Made of Air…
translation.editorial_note: This separately sourced witness of “The Poet’s Fate” keeps the same reviewed wording while preserving its more widely spaced lineation.
